# Security policy

## Scope

This policy covers the Ovxa site in this repository and, once deployed, the Ovxa program on Solana.

## Reporting

Please do not open a public issue for a security problem.

Use the private advisory feature of the repository host once the repository link is stated in the site's records. Until that link exists there is no public intake channel, and reports should wait for it rather than go to an unofficial address.

A useful report includes:

- what you found and where,
- steps to reproduce it,
- what an attacker could do with it,
- any fix you can suggest.

## What to expect

- Acknowledgement of a report as soon as someone on the team reads it.
- A plain explanation of whether the report is accepted and why.
- Credit in the fix notes if you want it.

## In scope

- Anything that lets a page visitor be shown a wrong contract address.
- Anything that makes an unstated record render as a live link.
- Content security policy gaps on the site.
- Faults in the program once it is deployed.

## Out of scope

- Reports that depend on a visitor's own device being compromised.
- Volume attacks against public endpoints that the site merely reads from.
- Price movement of any token.

## A note on addresses

The site shows one contract address, in the slot at the top of the page, and only when the register states it. If you ever see an address anywhere else that claims to belong to Ovxa, treat it as unofficial.
